fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-02-16, a document allegedly prepared using forged details of the complainant was used to seek a payment of Rs. 8,00,000. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-02-13 at about 14:50. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Murugan Sundaram, using the number 9000000207. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents and digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Forged papers reportedly used to process a transaction.
fields.Keywords: forgery, forged document, residential colony, afternoon, mobile number, suspect, digital document, documents
